7.4.3.5.2.2 Routine Control proxy
The routine control proxy provides access to routine control services in Application Software Clusters, which can be accessed by UDS diagnostic services 0x31 RoutineControl via the Dcm in the Host Software Cluster.

In this case, INOUT arguments (dataInOut (if applicable)) are used to transfer the
individual dataIn signals to the client, and to transfer back the individual dataOut
signals as joint array to the caller of the Dcm Low Proxy. The configuration of the
operations in the ClientServerInterfaces is according to the Dcm configuration of the Application Software Cluster. Additionally, IN arguments OpStatus (if applicable) and ConfirmationStatus (if applicable) are passed to the client,
